company.shortDescription: Levers helps B2B companies in reducing overdue payments, accelerate cash collection, and boost cashflow.
company.description: Levers helps B2B companies reduce overdue payments, accelerate cash collection, and boost cashflow. Our software integrates with your accounting system and streamlines your accounts receivable process using personalized reminders, flexible payment options, cross-team collaboration tools, and collection performance analytics.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that automates and manages B2B receivables collection by integrating ERP, email, payment gateways, and bank accounts to accelerate cash flow and reduce manual tasks.
productsAndServices.name: Levers B2B Receivables Collection Platform

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven system that makes human-like phone calls to customers for payment reminders, dispute resolution, and negotiation, following company policies and handling objections.
productsAndServices.name: AI Phone Call Collection

productsAndServices.description: A service that automates sending personalized payment reminders and follow-ups across multiple communication channels to reduce manual collection efforts.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Payment Follow-ups

productsAndServices.description: Automatically matches and reconciles incoming bank transactions with outstanding invoices to update financial records and flag discrepancies in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Bank Reconciliation Automation

productsAndServices.description: AI-powered tool that scans contracts, extracts billing details, and generates compliant invoices ready for sending, reducing manual invoice preparation.
productsAndServices.name: Contract to Invoice Automation

productsAndServices.description: Automatically assesses customer credit risk using bank data and payment behavior to recommend payment terms and monitor risk continuously post-onboarding.
productsAndServices.name: Customer Risk Assessment and Monitoring

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Pre Seed round raised $2,000,000, or 100% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $10,127,298 to $10,127,298, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 62 (+1 over 90 days) and market heat at 72 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include HighRadius, Versapay, Sidetrade.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
